metadata.title: MRO geometric states relative to Mars, 2024-01-01 TDB
limitations: A sampled navigation ephemeris, not direct measurements, real-time telemetry, or independent physical ground truth.
The response identifies MRO_MERGED and a reconstruction group, but not each underlying SPK segment or source-file checksum.
No state covariance or per-sample accuracy bound is supplied.
ICRF axes are not Mars body-fixed axes or Mars equator axes; a ground track needs an explicit body-frame transformation.
Five-minute samples do not resolve every event; linear drawing or interpolation is not an additional ephemeris product.
t_s is the exact 300-second query cadence. Printed 9-decimal JD values are retained but rounding produces up to about 40 microseconds of elapsed-time deviation.
